Hero_Desc_Heidi:
An Elven reporter for Monatium Broadcasting who races anywhere in pursuit of a scoop.
Because she considers her very existence sensational news, she tends to use selfies as the photographs for her articles.
The editor regularly scolds and throws her out for it, but nothing can stop her passion for a scoop.
Gacha_Result_HeroTitle_Heidi: The Reporter Who Is the Scoop
Album_Hate_Heidi: Rumors everyone already knows, dull incidents and accidents
Album_Hobby_Heidi: Rating restaurants, posting reviews on her blog
Album_Wish_Heidi: To personally write a scoop that sets Elias, no, the entire universe abuzz
Album_Heidi1: Heidi is a reporter for Monatium Broadcasting. Wherever an incident occurs, she appears to cover it. The problem is her enthusiasm regardless of time or place... Her habit of suddenly leaping out to demand an interview is remarkably inconvenient.
Album_Heidi2: Heidi appears wherever an incident occurs. She moves from place to place so quickly that I asked how she managed it, and she said she uses a delivery service. The parcel is Heidi herself. After proclaiming that Shoupan's delivery service was wonderful because it was so fast, she left to buy motion-sickness medicine.
Album_Heidi3: Heidi has been spending a great deal of time with Scizor lately, so I asked whether she was covering villains this time. She said not at all. When I asked what she was investigating, she replied that it was the dangers of gaming. Come to think of it, Monatium recently suffered another blackout... She will probably be writing piles of incident reports again soon.
Album_Heidi4: One day, a tremendous noise outside the Order drew me out, where I found Heidi being dragged away by Polan. Heidi was screaming about oppression of the press, so I stopped Polan and asked what had happened. Apparently, Heidi had been secretly following Erpin and taking photographs. I told Polan to carry on.
Album_Heidi5: Heidi complains that Monatium's press censorship is unbearably strict. When I asked what censorship she meant, she said every article she submits is rejected because this or that cannot be published. When she posts rejected articles on the darknet out of frustration, each one is immediately deleted. I asked what the articles concerned. Elena's corruption and private life, apparently. It is a wonder Heidi still has her job.
Album_Heidi6: I warned the scoop-obsessed Heidi to be careful or she might end up at the Weekend Farm. Her eyes lit up as she asked whether I knew where it was, declared an article about it would be a sensation, and demanded that I contact her for an interview if I ever visited. Heidi is truly frightening.
Album_Heidi7: Only a few Apostles joined the dangerous journey to find a new World Tree, but Heidi secretly hid among the bread supplies. When I demanded to know why she would do something so dangerous, her eyes shone as she declared that scoops require risk and she was already prepared. It was too late to send the eager Heidi back, so she came with us. I suspect I will endure her endless interviews for some time.

LoveHeroCancel_Heidi: Did you find a scoop even more sensational than me...?
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Hate1: Declaring that food with no flavor, aroma, or excitement could not be further from a scoop, she switched off her camera entirely.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Hate2: Perhaps because of its simple appearance, she threatened to expose the banquet hall for serving a halfhearted dish.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like1: She often eats it while out reporting because it is convenient, and says she never tires of it no matter how often she has it. She finished it in no time.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like2: She said it was the kind of dish worth photographing and showing off, then spent ages taking selfies before finally eating it.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like3: Saying it warmed her body after exhausting days spent chasing scoops, she finished the entire bowl.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like4: After savoring it for a long while, she said she hoped to uncover a heartwarming scoop at Christmas.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like5: Apparently, the tart flavor stimulates her frontal lobe, giving her brilliant ideas and making articles flow effortlessly.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like6: Saying the burst of honey inside felt like a camera shutter firing, she carefully chewed them one by one.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like7: She savored it for a long time, remembering how she used to peel and eat them one by one through her tears after the editor scolded her as a trainee reporter.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like8: She says eating this mysteriously fills her with energy, leaving her unfazed even after several consecutive nights of overtime.
Food_ChefNote_Heidi_Like9: The different flavors reminded her of her own articles, each containing a fresh topic, and she felt an immediate kinship with them.
